tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently stayed at a hotel called 'Coastal Retreat' during your vacation. While you were generally satisfied with the service, there were several problems with the room's features and overall condition. You want to inform the hotel manager, Mr. Rodriguez, about these issues. Write an email to Mr. Rodriguez.
bullets: Describe the issues you encountered with the room.
Explain how these issues affected your stay.
Request some form of compensation for the inconvenience caused.
tasks.subject: Issues with hotel room
